Causes and fixes:

1. **Token bucket never refills when polled.** `_refill` truncated the gained tokens with `int()` but still advanced the clock, so fractional time was lost. It now adds the float amount ([bucket.py:25](~/AppData/Local/Temp/agent-ab-bughunt-ratelimit__haiku-high__r1-a0-7ww4sp48/throttle/bucket.py:25)). I also snap values within 1e-9 of a whole token: ten 0.1 s polls otherwise leave `0.9999999999999999` and deny a request at exactly 1 s.
2. **Sliding window expires late.** The expiry test used `<` where it needs `<=` ([window.py:24](~/AppData/Local/Temp/agent-ab-bughunt-ratelimit__haiku-high__r1-a0-7ww4sp48/throttle/window.py:24)).
3. **Routes share one budget.** The limiter cache was keyed by `(client, rule.algo)`, so any two rules with the same algorithm shared state. It is now keyed by `(client, rule.key)` ([limiter.py:49](~/AppData/Local/Temp/agent-ab-bughunt-ratelimit__haiku-high__r1-a0-7ww4sp48/throttle/limiter.py:49)), which also fixes `active()`.
4. **Equal priority sorted by name.** `run_due` now sorts by submission sequence ([scheduler.py:100](~/AppData/Local/Temp/agent-ab-bughunt-ratelimit__haiku-high__r1-a0-7ww4sp48/throttle/scheduler.py:100)). Retries keep their `seq`, so they keep their place.
5. **Back-off one step too long.** The exponent is now `factor ** (retry_number - 1)` ([backoff.py:19](~/AppData/Local/Temp/agent-ab-bughunt-ratelimit__haiku-high__r1-a0-7ww4sp48/throttle/backoff.py:19)).
6. **One retry too few.** The scheduler check is now `retries_left > 0` ([scheduler.py:130](~/AppData/Local/Temp/agent-ab-bughunt-ratelimit__haiku-high__r1-a0-7ww4sp48/throttle/scheduler.py:130)), and `retry_call` raises when `retry_number >= retries` ([retry.py:18](~/AppData/Local/Temp/agent-ab-bughunt-ratelimit__haiku-high__r1-a0-7ww4sp48/throttle/retry.py:18)).
7. **Retry-After rounded down.** It now uses `ceil`, applied after `round(x, 9)`. Without the rounding, float noise overshoots: `0.3 / 0.1` is `3.0000000000000004`, which would print `"4"` for a 3 s wait ([limiter.py:29](~/AppData/Local/Temp/agent-ab-bughunt-ratelimit__haiku-high__r1-a0-7ww4sp48/throttle/limiter.py:29)).

The fixes:
